m: Sharp bristles of *grass* poke from the ear of grain beside a *tombstone*: the **awn**.
A *strong arm* under the *moon* pulls tight like a *bamboo* fibre: a **tendon**.
An *ear* presses to the *pit* of the interview room; one *puff of breath* says yes: you are **employed**.
*Gold coins* dangle under a *blanket* from a bend shaped like an *elbow*: a **hook**.
*Twins* snap a branch off a *tree* in the *sun* and fence with the **stick**.
Someone stole his *robe*, and his *mouth* opens wide: **shout**!
Under the *moon*, a *white dove* squeezes out tiny drops of *water*: a **gland** at work.
Tie *dark thread* tight across a *bow*: the **string**.
A *campfire* blazes as a *bent knife* stirs the coals in a *mortar*: leaping **flames**.
A *woman* tugs and twirls a man's long *beard*: she **plays with** it.
Under a *shed*, a tall *standing person* stoops and **looks down** at the child's *thumb*.
From the top of the *cliff*, the *village* looks tiny: **one hundredth** of its real size.
His *standing heart* skips a beat, and he can only **stare blankly**.
Under the *cliff*, guests in *summer hats* drag *trudging feet* up endless steps: a **tall building**.
His *glare* softens, and he speaks from the *heart*: **earnest**.
A *side dish* set on every *tall stool* in the hall: a **rich** feast.
*Gold coins* buy a shiny metal *nail*: hammer the **nail** in.
Under the big *roof* live only a **few** people.
Under a *cliff*, a broken *halberd*, a *covered mouth*; both *standing heart* and *heart* ache at the lost battle: what a **pity**.
A *helping hand* **throws down** the *lid* with a crash.
A *right hand*, another *right hand*, a third *right hand* stack each *cloth cover* on a *stepladder*: **pile up**.
A *left hand* tickles your *mouth* with *grass* until your *heart* boils: he **provokes** you.
A *mouth* in the *tent* says the *moon* is like a *standing knife*: an **analogy**.
*Small speech bubbles* sing notes from a *scaffold* hung with *antlers* in the *sun*: read the **chart**.
A *ghost* haunts his *standing heart* for what he did: **ashamed**.
The *king*'s *white dove* glows in the *campfire* light: **radiant**.
*Footsteps* follow the team marching behind its **badge**.
*Water drops* run off the *roof* into the *valley*, and the salt **dissolves**.
A *person* slips on the *hillside* and **falls** to the *soil*.
Pour a bucket on the *embers* to **cut short** the fire.
A cloth hung from a *pole* inside an *archway*: a **towel**.
*Water drops* pour into a *dish* until they spill everywhere: **overflowing**.
*Water drops* **spray** over the *bird nest*.
A man with *grey hair* shovels *soil* into the hole all day in the *sun*: **block up** the leak.
A cup as cool as *icicles* and thin as a *tile*: no one could *yawn* at fine **porcelain**.
One *mouth* and another *mouth* chant over a *small table*: a magic **spell**.
A *woman* who shoots a *bow* like a *big man*: Mum's sister, your **aunt**.
Cut a *tree* branch to beat the *wheat* behind the *curtains*: a **club**.
The *magistrate* opens his *mouth* to rule every *hillside* around: the **county**.
Hot *water drops* fill a pool in the *valley*: take a **bath**.
A *woman* raises one *eyebrow* above a twinkling *eye*: **charming**.
A *fish* and a bowl from the *grain stalk*: one good meal and he **revives**.
*Water drops* flow past a *sparrow* on the bank: the **Huai River**.
A *mouth* yells as the *scissors* snip the *grass* far too short: **hey**!
A *lying man* and his *twins* giggle at a rude noise under the blanket: a **fart**.
*Water drops* of sap seep from the *tree*, and you brush them on: shiny **lacquer**.
*Water drops* keep falling, and a *claw* loads a *shoulder pole* far too high: **excessive**.
Above the *wavy river* and the *rice field*, birds build high in a *tree*: a **nest**.
A *mouth* pulls back the *curtains* and points with a *knife*: he **orders** the servants about.
A *helping hand* leaps a *hurdle*, slips behind the *curtains* and **composes** a book.
A *mouth* blows across a hollow *brush handle*: a long **whistle**.
*Water drops* trapped behind a *picket fence* go still and green: **stagnant**.
The *king* plants a flower with thorns as sharp as a *cane*: a **rose**.
A *stone* as big as the whole *page*: **large**.
Swap *gold coins* for a *ladle* of bait, then cast your line and **fish**.
A *bug* flutters from a *tree* halfway across the *globe*: a **butterfly**.
Under the *moon*, a boy climbs a *tree* and scrapes his **knee**.
A *woman* with long *legs* walks by: **good-looking**.
*Grass* grows so thick on the *cliff* that you need a *halberd* to hack through: **luxuriant**.
A tailor stands the *torso* in an *open crate* and cuts with *scissors* to fit the whole **body**.
All day, *scissors* trim the paperwork of a **minor official**.
A *prowling dog* chases a big **ape** across the *soil*.
Logs lashed in a *cross*, *crumbs* of mud packed between: a **stockade**.
A *woman* opens her *mouth* and her *heart*: I **forgive** you.
*Water drops* run through an *open crate* made of *tree* planks: a **canal**.
Under the *cliff*, *upstairs* and down, holding a *halberd* or sweeping *crumbs*: all your **relatives**.
A *clam* opens beneath the *cliff* at seven each morning: the **fifth Earthly Branch**.
A *boat* with sails as white as a *white dove*: a big **ship**.
Draw the *curtains*, cut the ribbon with a *knife*, read out the *page*: **issue** the new law.
A *standing heart* trembles as the *king* lets fly a *white dove* to signal war: **anxiety**.
A *prowling dog* sneaks into the *melon* patch at night: a **fox**.
*Small speech bubbles* blow past on the *wind*, poking fun at everyone: he **satirizes** them.
Trying to eat with *bamboo* that still has its *roots* on: how **dumb**.
A *shirt* as long as a *blanket*, wrapped round like a coiled *cobra*: a **gown**.
A *mouth* laughs from *sun*rise till the *moon*, marking a *cross* for each mistake: **ridicule**.
A *mouth* sips, and the steam rises like *spread wings*: **coffee**.
A *right hand* hurls a bucket of *water drops*: **splash**!
At the *crossroads*, a horse bites on a bridle bit of *gold coins*: it must **hold** it **in** its **mouth**.
A *standing person* hangs his *horns* behind the *curtains* and slumps like a *bowing man*: **weary**.
A sponge soaks up the *water drops* and holds them inside: it **contains** them.
Just a *pinch* of a *sparrow*: a **small bird**.
The *sun* rises ten times under its *blanket* of cloud: a **ten-day period**.
A *standing person* stuck between *three planks*, one *rice field* and another *rice field*: stiff and **rigid**.
A *helping hand* rips the *candy* wrapper so hard an *axe* could not do better: **tear** it.
Under the *moon*, an arm stretches out like a *branch*: a **limb**.
A *dragon* lies stretched out on the *soil*, its back forming a raised **crop row**.
A *big man* with a mighty *bow*: one of the **eastern tribes**.
A *rabbit* darts off down the *road*: it **escapes**.
*Grass* as tall and pointed as a *spear*: **reeds**.
A *standing person* far from home shows the locals a *dancer*'s steps from his homeland: an **emigrant**.
A huge carriage big enough to carry everyone: **the public**.
Inside a brick *cave*, *clay jars* bake in fierce heat: a **kiln**.
*Water drops* mixed with *sun*-baked *soil* turn cloth dark: a **black dye**.
*Grass* sprouting from *water drops* in a marshy *seedbed*: **cattail**.
A *small speech bubble* says, "Oh, these old *antlers*? They're nothing": **modest**.
A willow *tree*, the *lid* of a teapot on a *small table* by the lake: **Hangzhou**.
A *big man* opens his *mouth* wide as it finally clicks: **oh, I see**!
A *towel* hides cheat notes in the *grass* until the teacher's *cane* comes down: **fraud**.
A *mouth* gives praise as a *shell* medal is pinned on a *strong arm*: **merit**.
A *standing knife* **scrapes** your *tongue* clean.
Past the *hillside*, people trim hedges with *scissors* behind *curtains* and *lid*-like roofs: the **suburbs**.
A *woman* stands alone among the *icicles*: cold and **mournful**.
A *helping hand* gathers *wheat* in arms spread like *curtains*: **cup** it in both hands.
*Water drops* cover the shirt left in the tub: let it **soak**.
A block of *stone* carried in the crook of your *elbow*: a **brick**.
Two *wood slices* for legs and handles, with a big *eye* of a pot on top: a bronze **cauldron**.
*Bamboo* woven around a *dish*: a **basket**.
*Grass* wrapping, an *assistant* fanning the *embers*: **steam** the buns.
A *side dish* pressed flat under a *door bar* with *horns*: a round **flat cake**.
Lay a *lid* over a *rice field* to measure it: one **mu** of land.
Under the *moon*, the doctor points to a bean-shaped organ: the **kidney**.
A *runner* gasps his way up the *hillside*: so **steep**.
A *pole* with three hooked toes: a bird's *talon*, its **claw**.
A *bent knife* for an ear and a *drop* for a tail: a **rabbit**.
In the *mirror body*, a man with a *war club* guards full storehouses: **plentiful** grain.
A *little fortune stick* and a single *shell*, kept pure and given to no one: **chaste**.
In the *grass*, a *standing person* leads a *child* by the *left hand* and says hire this one: he **recommends** him.
A *mouth* bites on a *silver medal* and cannot speak: **mute**.
A *left hand* burns wood from the *mountain* in a *campfire*: black **charcoal**.
*Soil* heaped up, a name cut like a *tattoo* into the stone: a **grave**.
An *eye* as tired as a *flat tyre* keeps **blinking**.
A *helping hand* and a *thumb* wrestle over the *seedbed*: **fight**.
A *person* covers his *mouth*: **cough**.
A *helping hand* **draws together** the *dragon*'s scattered scales.
Mum's brother pounds rice in a *mortar*, then works the *rice field* with a *strong arm*: your **maternal uncle**.
The *sun* is hidden behind a growing *sapling*: **dark**.
A *helping hand* lifts the *lid* off the boss's box **without permission**.
A *big man* gets a cool haircut, *scissors* snipping on every side: he feels **bright and clear**.
One *mouth*, another *mouth*, a *strong arm* carrying cups: a busy **café**.
A *helping hand* **puts** the bag by the *gate*, where *trudging feet* trip on it and a *mouth* complains.
At the *small altar*, a *comb* and *splashing water* clean the coins: your **official salary**.
By the *stop sign*, a *spoon* feeds a mother *sparrow* sitting on her eggs: **female**.
A *mouth* blows under the *moon*, *sprinkles* of shrill sound: the guard's **whistle**.
Tie the *sail* firmly to the *workbench*: **secure** it.
*Silk thread* woven so fine the *moon* shines through and every *mouth* admires it: **thin silk**.
A *bug* carrying a shell patterned like a *rice field*, curled like a *silk skein*: a **snail**.
A *robe* is pulled round a *rice field* scarecrow on a *tree* post: **wrap** it up.
Meat hung over a *hurdle* to dry in the *sun*: *sun-dried meat* from **the past**.
A *cart* parked by a *drying rack* on the hilltop: a **high pavilion** with a view.
A *small speech bubble* claims a *person* with *feathers* and *bristles* can fly: **erroneous**.
*Small speech bubbles* whisper from behind a *tree*, all round the *globe*: a **spy**.
A head like a *bent knife* pokes out of a shell marked with a *lightning bolt*: a **turtle**.
A *woman* with her *nose* in the air but a kind *heart*: your son's wife, the **daughter-in-law**.
A *woman* feeds her *sheep* spicy roots: **ginger**.
An *eye* hidden in the *roof*'s dark shadow: he gropes about **blindly**.
A *rabbit* trapped under a *cloth cover* for a crime it never did: **injustice**.
A black *bird* with a beak like a *fang*: a **crow**.
*Grass*, *wheat* stalks and dust from the *road* cling to *trudging feet* and hair: **disheveled**.
Over a *hurdle*, through *curtains*, past a sleeping *cobra*: a narrow **lane**.
The *king* finds a **gem** between one *tree* and another *tree*.
